title: Reach Billion Users
tagline: Attract a billion Telegram users to your dApp on Ethereum using this dev kit

prizes.title: Most Innovative use of Pyth pull oracle (Price Feeds)

description:
Telegram will soon have a billion users. At the same time, every user has a built-in crypto wallet in their app.

There's no doubt that developers of Ethereum apps will be happy to attract these people to their projects. This project is designed to make that process easier.

It's a dev kit to integrate Telegram Open Network into your dApp on Ethereum without headaches in a few clicks and reach a billion Telegram users.
how_its_made:
Optimism, Base, Conduit, and Mode networks are used for smart contracts that handle all operations for account abstraction, paymaster, and token exchange.

Pyth oracle is used to get price feeds for exchanging user toncoins to usdt.

Blockscout is used as the main block explorer for the links that the library provides to developers and users.
